first_missing_criterion: canonical BUILDING_PRESENT parcel AOI plus Belfast City 2006 North East Zone archive-internal DTM tile filenames and a dataset-specific official CRS declaration. This unused official public no-login Spatial NI glossary window materially changes method from file/download and CKAN harvest endpoints to the Spatial NI metadata/service ontology: it explicitly states that Northern Ireland uses the Irish Grid Coordinate system, defines grid references, LIDAR, DTM/DEM and Spatial NI metadata, but it does not bind that general coordinate-system statement to the Belfast City 2006 LiDAR resource and exposes no North East archive/tile filename or coverage geometry.
